'''Made in Heaven''' is a cutscene in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]] assigned to [[protagonist]] [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] by countryside criminal [[Catalina]] from her [[Catalina's Hideout|hideout]] in [[Fern Ridge]], [[Red County]], [[San Andreas in GTA III Era|San Andreas]].

==Mission==
Catalina is in a bad mood and wants Carl to know that she doesn't love him anymore and wants to be just partners. This mission unlocks the last robbery mission that would be available.

==Script==
'''Catalina''': Asshole!

'''CJ''': Damn, what'd I do now!?

'''Catalina''': You all the fucking same, eh. I see it on television. I read it in books. I hear it in music. You all the same. Fuck this, fuck that. Well, fuck you!

'''CJ''': Baby, I'm sorry...

'''Catalina''': I gave to you, as a woman. No! No more! From now on, we just business partners. OK?

'''CJ''': Eh, if that's how you want it. But I mean you're breakin' my heart...

'''Catalina''': I'm warning you. I'm in a really bad fucking mood. Today I kill everybody who fucks with me! Especially you! Move!
